description: One generated tax form. W-2 and 1099-NEC are per recipient per calendar year; 941, OQ and WA-ESD are per company per quarter; OR-WR is per company per year. Every computed box and line value is kept in form_data_json, so a form filed months ago can be read back exactly as it was computed. Status moves from Draft to Generated (values computed) to Filed (submitted to the agency) or Amended (superseded by a corrected form).

fields.description: The calendar year the form covers, as YYYY.
fields.label: Tax Year

fields.description: Quarterly forms only. Blank on W-2, 1099-NEC and OR-WR.
fields.label: Quarter

fields.description: Per-recipient forms only. The employee a W-2 is for.
fields.label: Recipient

fields.description: 1099-NEC only. The contractor the form is for.
fields.label: Related Party

fields.description: Every box and line value the generator computed, as JSON. This is the record — the form on paper is a rendering of it.
fields.label: Form Data

fields.description: The rendered or agency-issued PDF, attached by hand. Nothing in this app renders an official Copy A.
fields.label: Generated PDF

fields.description: WHICH RETURNS THIS BLOCK APPLIES TO. Forms 941, OR-WR, OQ and WA-ESD carry a penalties-of-perjury declaration signed by an officer or authorised agent of the employer. Forms W-2 and 1099-NEC DO NOT: the recipient copies carry no signature line at all, and the declaration for a W-2 batch is made once on the Form W-3 transmittal that accompanies it. Leaving this block empty on a W-2 is therefore correct and raises nothing.
fields.label: Signature

fields.description: The printed name of the person who signed the declaration. A separate fact from the account that made the call — one authorised person filing on behalf of another is a real thing in an office, and the MCP Action Log records which account, whoever's name went in the box.
fields.label: Signer Name

fields.description: Their title. The declaration is made by an officer of the employer or an authorised agent, and which of the two it was is the question an agency asks second.
fields.label: Signer Title

fields.description: The signature capture. Filed with collect_form_signature, stored private, and surfaced by the tax_form_signature_missing compliance rule while it is empty on a return that is Generated or later.
fields.label: Signature

fields.description: When the declaration was signed. A signature image on its own is not an electronic signature — the record is the image, the moment and the address it came from, which is why all three columns are here.
fields.label: Signed At

fields.description: Whatever the agency gave back — an EFTPS trace number, a Frances Online confirmation, an ESD receipt.
fields.label: Confirmation Number

fields.description: Set on a corrected form to point at the one it replaces.
fields.label: Amends

name: Tax Form
